definitions.explanation: The medically induced loss of sensation or consciousness, used during surgery or dental procedures.

examples.japanese: {麻酔|ますい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}いて→効く：01932_kiku⟧きた。
⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧{麻酔|ますい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: General anesthesia was administered before the surgery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{局所|きょくしょ}{麻酔|ますい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}って→打つ：01221_utsu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{痛|いた}かった→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: I had local anesthesia at the dentist, but it still hurt a little.

notes:
USAGE:
Common verbs: {麻酔|ますい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to administer anesthesia), {麻酔|ますい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (for anesthesia to take effect), {麻酔|ますい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (for anesthesia to wear off).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧{麻酔|ますい}: general anesthesia
- {局所|きょくしょ}{麻酔|ますい}: local anesthesia
- {麻酔|ますい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to administer anesthesia
- {麻酔|ますい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: anesthesia takes effect
- {麻酔|ますい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: anesthesia wears off
- {麻酔科医|ますいかい}: anesthesiologist
